R8 (Priority 0, 2026-09-20) — durable three-part jersey join on all seven PS4 titles:

    stockteamjerseys (teamartid, variant, style)  <->  ge_nhl_skaterjerseytexturepack (Team, UniformVariation, JerseyFit)

Records, per title: source identities (vault/schema/DB hashes), exact denominators (DB rows, distinct DB triples,
duplicate DB rows per triple; pack records, distinct pack triples, packs per triple), the full unmatched sets on both
sides, every multiple-match triple with its candidate collections (key, DebugName, every typed attribute incl. the
unnamed flag-4 Int32 and the OnOff enum, the ten referenced texture paths), and the DB-side row attributes of the
matched triples (yearstart/yearend/variantlegend/isdefault/active/... where the title has them).

Read-only. Reuses the R7 reader (vlt_collections.Vault/Schema/Decoder) and the R6 DB helpers; nothing is written
except <out.json>. Runtime ≈ 5 min for all seven titles (vault parse dominates).

Usage: python r8_jersey_triples.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,nhl15,...]
